reading.action: Explore the third floor again with a forge-minded eye, searching specifically for equipment or tools usable for smithing — something better than his makeshift river-stone hammer and bare-floor anvil.

check_tool_search.note: Low 'ruined tools' band. The floor WAS a working forge — tool-remains everywhere — but Tower-rot has claimed nearly all of it: anvils cracked and half-buried, hammers rust-welded to slag, tongs crumbling at a touch. He digs out ONE sound salvage: a hafless iron hammer-head, deeply pitted but core-sound. Marginal but real striking upgrade over the river-stone (carried in narrative judgment, not the item note). The real anvil is ruined; the bare floor stays his anvil.

reading.result: ITEM ACQUIRED: Iron hammer-head (hafless, pitted, core-sound) — a marginal smithing upgrade; needs a haft to use. The forge-floor confirmed as a dead, rot-ruined forge; no other usable gear (anvil cracked/buried). COST: Stamina 27 -> 24 (-3 search labor); HP/Focus unchanged; no XP (marginal find). The way up off floor 3 stands open and unclimbed; the Furnace-heart still charges in the floor-2 brazier. STOP at his decision point — a rough new striker in hand, the climb still ahead. NO assumed next action. NO Tower reset.
